title: Warming Up - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Warming Up in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Warming Up is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases damage by 5% each turn, stacking up to five times.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: Increases damage by 5% each turn, stacking up to five times.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
